info.name: Arbiter — Claims Classification Module
info.description:
Testing collection for the claims analysis and classification engine.

**Available mock policies**:
- POL-CEL-2024-001 (Laura Fernández, insuredId 40.123.456)
- POL-CEL-2025-099 (Marcelo Gómez, insuredId 30.555.777)
- POL-CEL-2026-042 (Sofía Martínez, insuredId 42.987.654)

**Flow**:
1. POST /api/v1/claims (multipart: "claim" JSON part + optional "files") — creates the claim, analyzes any attached documents with Ollama and triggers classification immediately (202 Accepted). The response sets `claimId` as a collection variable automatically.
2. (optional, any time later) POST /api/v1/claims/{{claimId}}/attachments — add more documents (e.g. after a FALTA_DOCUMENTACION result) and reclassify automatically.
3. GET /api/v1/claims/results — queries results table (one row per classification)
